_about: The perspective confusion pairs the hosts showed on slide 22 of the deep dive (issue #17), for the report in
bench/perspective_report.py (issue #34). This file is data, not code: as in
src/galaxus/serve/demo/hero_rules.json it is the only place in this part of the lane where a class name is
written down, and every name here is checked against galaxus.data.classes when it loads.
The percentages are the hosts' own model (slide 21: Qwen 3.5 9B), NOT ours. They are a target to aim at and a
reference line on the figure; they are never our result. Our own numbers come from the predictions file and
the holdout human labels, and no number goes in front of a judge unless it is in results/metrics.json
